title: SEPARATOR FOR RECHARGEABLE BATTERY AND RECHARGEABLE LITHIUM BATTERY INCLUDING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a separator for a rechargeable battery and a rechargeable lithium battery including the same. The separator includes a porous substrate, and a heat resistant layer positioned on at least one surface of the porous substrate. The heat resistant layer includes a copolymer including an imide group-containing structural unit and a urea group-containing structural unit, and is porous. It is possible to provide a rechargeable battery with high heat resistance.
